metadata.description: Official ArmorIQ marketplace for Claude Code security plugins.

plugins.name: armorclaude
plugins.description: Intent-based security enforcement for Claude Code: declared plans, policy rules, intent-drift blocking, CSRG cryptographic proofs, and audit logging. Production-hardcoded URLs (api.armoriq.ai + iap.armoriq.ai).

plugins.name: armorclaude-dev
plugins.description: Intent-based security enforcement for Claude Code, dev variant. Talks to the production backend (api.armoriq.ai) by default; ARMORIQ_ENV=staging or ARMORIQ_ENV=development switch to staging or a local stack. Tracks the dev branch HEAD; install only if you're contributing to armorClaude or running a local stack.
